title: Easton Echo Joins Quantum Frequency Records
subtitle: Synth-Pop / Pop Rock · Philadelphia, PA
excerpt: A songwriter with a cinematic instinct for turning ordinary moments into unforgettable pop songs.
body: Quantum Frequency Records welcomes Easton Echo to the roster. Born Easton Cole and raised outside Philadelphia, the singer, songwriter and producer has built a reputation for emotionally direct writing wrapped in expansive synths, ringing guitars and unmistakably modern pop production. Easton has a rare ability to make enormous songs feel personal. His work lives somewhere between late-night confession and stadium-sized release, with melodies designed to stay with you long after the song ends. QFR was drawn to the same quality that defines the rest of the roster: Easton already knows who he is. Our job is to help him take that sound further.
